quirks.label: Leg flag on every shot
quirks.expect: The same survey: a leg is reported at its first shot and refined by the next two.

quirks.label: No leg flag
quirks.expect: The same survey: three close shots still make a leg, by closeness alone.

quirks.label: 33-byte packets
quirks.expect: The same survey: the short packet form decodes.

quirks.label: Lost acks (packets repeat)
quirks.expect: The same survey: every repeat is acknowledged but written once.

quirks.label: Calibration shots mixed in
quirks.expect: The same survey: calibration packets are acknowledged and left out, and the log says so.

quirks.label: Accuracy errors
quirks.expect: The same survey, with some shots carrying an "accuracy error" warning.

quirks.label: Lost acks (frames repeat)
quirks.expect: The same survey: each repeat is acknowledged again and written once.

quirks.label: Long shots (firmware bit-16 fault)
quirks.expect: Shots past 32.768 m carry the SAP5 firmware fault; they must still read their true length, not 65 m too long.

quirks.label: Repeated packets
quirks.expect: The same survey: a repeated packet is written once.

quirks.label: No error indication
quirks.expect: The same survey: each shot is written when the next begins, or after 400 ms.

quirks.label: Missed shots (index jumps)
quirks.expect: The same survey, and the log says shots were missed.

quirks.label: Scan shots (splays)
quirks.expect: The same survey: scan shots (type 1) are ordinary readings.

quirks.label: Zero-length shots
quirks.expect: The same survey: shots with no length are ignored, and the log says so.

quirks.label: Instrument errors
quirks.expect: The same survey, with some shots carrying "the target moved".

quirks.label: Repeated indications
quirks.expect: The same survey: a repeated primary is written once.
